review.notes: Triage review of all 42 physical pages. Full structural scan: the document contains no code fences at all (0 opens/closes, verified against the repo's fence-balance rules) and carries 18 image embeds for the UI walkthrough screenshots. Automated normalized 4-gram containment of every PDF page's text layer against the OCR markdown; every low-containment page (physical 6, 7, 8, 9, 11, 12, 17, 29, 38) resolved to benchmark tables whose values exist intact in the OCR's HTML tables - the PDF text layer's reading order for tables interleaves columns, which explains the misses (verified Table 6 'Multilingual performance' row-by-row including English 0.572/0.580 through Yoruba 0.473/0.426, Table 12 safety-training table header, and sampled values 0.932/0.925/0.979/0.931/0.991/0.958 all present exactly once in their expected tables). References [1]-[6+] present with full author lists; final page (Watchlist/trusted-access closing) matches the PDF text layer. Line-by-line review was done on diff contexts of the flagged pages; the remaining prose pages matched the text layer at >=0.83 containment, and no page-bottom footnote class exists in this card (its notes are inline). No patches required; screenshot-internal UI text is carried by the embedded images.

unresolved.evidence: All flagged tables were checked against the PDF text layer (values and captions present in the OCR HTML), but no table was compared cell-by-cell against a rendered page, and numeric columns were not exhaustively enumerated.
